text:
rachel: Quick broadcast for this week's release train. Two items: tightened freeze policy for sensitive infra changes, and a short canary tomorrow 16:00 UTC.

tony: what triggered the tighter freeze?

rachel: Follow-up from Friday's DB schema drift. Postmortem recommended a 72h pause for schema/cache/KV contract changes until migration-divider rollout finishes.

noah: timeline? is the pause org-wide?

rachel: Effective immediately: 72h pause (until 16:00 UTC in three days). No schema, cache infra, or KV contract changes without an explicit freeze-exception signed by @rachel and @anya. Non-breaking bugfixes and docs are OK.

anya: I'll review exceptions. Open a PR labeled "freeze-exception" and include the checklist. Expect ~2hr review SLA.

tony: emergency hotfix flow?

rachel: Tag PR, post in this thread, ping @anya + #eng-oncall. We will triage and, if needed, book a targeted canary slot.

deploy-bot: [info] Canary slot reserved: 2026-06-02 16:00:00 UTC. Slot 1h. Auto-rollback if 5xx_rate>0.7% or p95 latency >30% baseline.

noah: will runtime tweaks be allowed? we've got a serving-runtime tweak queued.

rachel: Runtime tweaks allowed but must not deploy alongside cache infra changes. Deploy order: control-plane -> serving-runtime -> frontend. No cache infra in same window.

ops-bot: [reminder] New policy: all schema migrations must include migration metrics and a dry-run plan. See /policies/migrations.

anya: For rolling migrations, include a migration-divider flag and a rollback path in the PR.

noah: adding the divider flag and dashboards to our PR now.

rachel: ACTIONS: 1) Teams with schema/cache/kv work - hold merges until exception approval. 2) Owners of runtime fixes - confirm deferral or mark urgent. 3) Oncall - watch p50/p95, 5xx, cache-miss, DB write latency.

tony: marking our runtime fix deferred to the canary.

deploy-bot: [notice] Auto-hold enforced for PRs touching schema/* or cache/* until 1955260311. To request exception, comment `@rachel please-exempt`.

noah: does this affect non-prod canaries?

rachel: Non-prod canaries OK for testing, but do not promote to prod unless exception approved.

oncall-bot: [postmortem link] DB schema drift: root cause = missing nullability check in migration, impact = increased write errors ~8m. Draft: /linked/postmortems/db-drift-2026-05-30.

anya: I'll run the exception queue morning batch at 09:30 UTC. If you need priority, DM me.

rachel: Thanks. We know this is friction but it's targeted to reduce risk during the migration rollouts. Keep updates here and in #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
